spec.claim_summary: The claim asserts that price relative to a slow moving average becomes more reliable when aligned across ten timeframes.
spec.untestable_reason: No entry trigger, moving-average lengths, exits, assets, or timeframes are specified and the core ten-timeframe alignment cannot be expressed as a single-timeframe rule.
assumptions: No asset is named so BTCUSDT is used only as a placeholder; no mechanical rule can be recovered regardless.
No timeframe is named so 1d is used only as a placeholder.
Direction, moving-average type and length, entry trigger, and exit are not stated.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: alignment and confirmation across 10 different timeframes requires multi-timeframe conditions which the schema cannot express, and this alignment is the heart of the claimed system.
